hostname.description: The Terraform Enterprise hostname to connect to. Defaults to app.terraform.io.

organization.description: The organization to apply to a resource if one is not defined on the resource itself.

ssl_skip_verify.description: Whether or not to skip certificate verifications.

token.description: The token used to authenticate with Terraform Enterprise. We recommend omitting the token which can be set as credentials in the CLI config file.

block.description: Terraform provider to patch/work alongside the TFE for resources/data sources that are yet to be implemented

key_id.description: The identity of the generated key

namespace.description: The provider, by namespace, that this GPG key is affiliated with.

organization.description: The organization name under which this GPG key will exist

namespace.description: The namespace under which the provider will exist. For provider registries with 'registy_name' == 'private' the namespace must match organization name

organization.description: The organization name under which this provider registry will exist

registry_name.description: The registry type for the provider. Must be 'public' or 'private'
